query:
SELECT
            (array_agg(data -> $2 ORDER BY id))[1] AS "value!",
            count(*) AS "count!",
            (array_agg(id ORDER BY id))[1:$3] AS "record_ids!",
            count(*) OVER () AS "total!"
        FROM custom_records
        WHERE entity_id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND data ->> $2 IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY data ->> $2
        HAVING count(*) > 1
        ORDER BY data ->> $2
        LIMIT $3
